title: Island of Orleans Taste and Drink Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
May be operated by a multi-lingual guide
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the authentic flavors of Quebec with Quebec Bus Tour’s Route des Saveurs, a signature small-group experience just 15 minutes from Old Quebec. Escape the city and explore Île d’Orléans, a historic island known for its scenic landscapes, charming villages, and views of the St. Lawrence River. Led by a passionate bilingual guide, this immersive tour takes you to selected local producers, including a cider house, a nougat maker, a vineyard, and an organic blackcurrant (cassis) farm. Enjoy tastings of local specialties while learning about the region’s traditions and craftsmanship. With its relaxed small-group format, this experience offers the perfect balance of discovery, flavor, and authenticity—one of the best things to do near Quebec City.
